request: Should we replace the daily stand-up meeting with a written async update, to cut the time engineers spend in meetings?
facts: For a four-week trial, the team of seven posted a written update in the team channel instead of meeting for the daily stand-up.
Calendar data shows time in meetings per engineer stayed at 6.5 hours a week during the trial, the same as in the four weeks before: the stand-up time went into ad-hoc calls instead.
The written update costs nothing, and going back means putting the meeting back on the calendar.
Six of the seven engineers want to keep the written update; they say they like reading it when it suits them. The seventh has no preference.
